items.title: Shots fired where gangster's funeral was advertised to be held
items.description: The ABC understands the funeral of Sydney gangster Lorenzo Lemalu was originally scheduled to take place at the venue in Punchbowl, but the plans were changed.

items.title: Live: Carpenter wins 100th cap as Matildas take on Mexico
items.description: The Matildas are back in action in Newcastle, taking on 28th-ranked Mexico in the first of two international friendly matches, with Ellie Carpenter set to make her 100th appearance. Follow live.

items.title: Live: Cowboys not going away against in-form Dolphins
items.description: North Queensland looks to mount a second-half fightback after the awarding of a controversial try in Townsville. Follow live.

items.title: Australia, NZ back friendship to endure 'volatile world'
items.description: Global volatility and economic turbulence have dominated annual talks between the leaders of Australia and New Zealand, Anthony Albanese and Christopher Luxon.

items.title: Diver dies after being bitten by 4.5m shark off Albany, WA
items.description: A male diver has died after an attack by a suspected 4.5-metre shark near Michaelmas Island, off WA's Albany coast, on Saturday morning.

items.title: What's driving Australia's lentil boom?
items.description: Australia's winter crop production is expected to be down this year, but lentils are bucking the trend and headed towards a record.

items.title: Live: Lions young gun kicking a QClash bag, Dockers claim record win

items.title: 'Everything looked real': How scammers are hijacking your holiday

items.title: How Everest guide survived six days alone with no oxygen and a few chocolates
items.description: A few chocolates found in his pocket and an avalanche may have been what saved Dawa Sherpa from almost certain death on Mount Everest.

items.title: A Sydney mother died after drinking 67 cups of water under 24-hour watch
items.description: When Tammy Shipley felt herself sliding into psychosis, she made a heartbreaking decision: She walked into a police station and asked to be arrested, believing prison would keep her safe. Here's what happened next.
